finalText:
It builds clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the noise, both from the bundler bump. In `src/core/options.js`, `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. In `src/net/retryPolicy.js`, `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed both.

The rest really was just noise. Deprecation warnings from Node internals, nothing to act on.
